findings.text: the fragment states the importer population ran "266 passed at base and 266 passed at head" at d92af4764, but the run's only importer logs (logs/baseline-importers.log and logs/after-importers.log, stamped 07:09 and 07:10, before the 08:54 refactor) carry no revision header, so a pre-refactor measurement is presented as head evidence and the done_when's importer clause is unmeasured at the landed head; nothing in the repository still references the removed _run_record_files, _within_tree or _cites_tree_or_file names, so the risk the arm would have covered is nil.

the deleted _within_tree wrapped both Path.resolve calls in an OSError guard returning False, so the predicate was total, while _cites_own_path resolves resolved_own and the cited candidate outside any guard; an unresolvable path in the run's own places now raises out of the review sweep's decline decision instead of declining the round, which is a narrow regression because a traceback replaces a recorded decline.
